response.original_title: Neyen Mapu, El Llamado del Lanín
response.overview: A deeply spiritual and political Mapuche perspective on the importance of restoring environmental balance around the Lanín volcano. Ancestral knowledge is shared with society as a whole, and society is called upon to care for this territory in the face of the advance of extractive tourism.
